statement: Costa reports that African Blue, its Moroccan business operating since 2007 with about 465 hectares, is broadening supply through a Zimbabwe Direct from Source project involving 11 growers and more than 300 hectares first planted in 2018, accounting for about 15 per cent of African Blue's annual sales. The varieties adopted are named as Kirra, Akala, Corindi Verdure and Arana.
